items: 10.5" PixelSense 10-Point Touch Display, Full HD (1920 x 1280), IPS.

Large capacity with unlimited possibilities - The Microsoft Surface Go 2 has up to 4GB RAM smoothly run your applications, as well as multiple programs and browser tabs all at once. Up to 64GB SSD boots up quickly, This Surface Tablet get to files faster, and have room for loads of files with the quick solid state drive.

Experience speed and performance - The Microsoft Surface Laptop features a powerful Intel Pentium Gold 4425Y Processor (2 Cores, 4 Threads, 2 MB Cache, Base Frequency at 1.7 GHz). Microsoft refurbished Laptop meeting the fast and stable operation of most programs.
Multi port response to high demand-1 x USB-C, 3.5mm headphone jack, with Multi-Stream Technology, This Surface Go Laptop allows you to fully enjoy the pleasure brought by technology.

Advanced Security-This Microsoft Surface laptop installed Windows 11 Pro provides more security features and options to help users better protect the security of personal and work data. At the same time, Manage and configure through group policies, facilitating centralized management and control for enterprise level users.
